pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygonal patches with sharp edge transitions. Spatial area is maximal on the neck and shoulder, diminishing toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light pelage with relatively uniform pixel thickness. Topological nodes are primarily tri-junctions, maintaining network integrity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck and upper shoulder, defining the mane profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism is present on the posterior flank near the tail base.
